description: This file contains functions and data structures for detecting, normalizing, and mapping RFC6838 media types (MIME types) to processing modes within the ISCC SDK. It includes functions for guessing media types from file data or filenames, normalizing media type strings, checking support, and converting media types to processing modes.

methods.name: mediatype_and_mode
methods.description: Detects the media type and processing mode for a given file path or filename.

methods.name: mediatype_guess
methods.description: Guesses the media type from raw data or filename, using extension or content sniffing.

methods.name: mediatype_normalize
methods.description: Normalizes a media type string to a standard form.

methods.name: mediatype_supported
methods.description: Checks if a media type is supported.

methods.name: mediatype_from_name
methods.description: Guesses media type from filename or URL based on extension.

methods.name: mediatype_from_data
methods.description: Guesses media type by sniffing raw header data.

methods.name: mediatype_clean
methods.description: Cleans a media type string, removing encoding info.

methods.name: mediatype_to_mode
methods.description: Converts a media type to a processing mode (text, image, audio, video).
